title: Enterprise LLM Model Version Upgrade, Deprecation Management, 5% Shadow Traffic Evaluation & Zero-Regression Migration Selection

tiers.tier: Tier 1: Cloud Provider 'Auto-Upgrade on Retirement Date' (`100% Overnight Cutover Without Testing`)
tiers.architecture: Leaving Azure OpenAI / Bedrock model deployments on `Auto-Upgrade` or changing the model string overnight on the provider's retirement deadline

tiers.tier: Tier 2: Manual Spreadsheet QA Sampling (`50 Prompts Tested by Hand Before Cutover`)
tiers.architecture: Product managers manually testing 50 sample prompts in a playground before flipping 100% of production traffic from Model v1 to Model v2

tiers.tier: Tier 3: Offline Golden-Set Benchmark Only (Ignoring Live Production Edge-Case Drift & Verbosity Shift)
tiers.architecture: Running a static 500-prompt synthetic eval in CI, then switching 100% of production traffic at once without live shadow mirroring or canary traffic shifting

tiers.tier: Tier 4: AI Gateway `5%` Async Shadow Mirroring + Pairwise Diff Judge (`JSON / Verbosity / Refusal Drift`) + Automated Prompt Calibration (`DSPy / Prompt Optimizer`) + `10%->50%->100%` Blue-Green PTU Shift
tiers.architecture: Mirroring 5% of live traffic asynchronously to Model v2 in shadow mode, auto-detecting verbosity/refusal/JSON drift, auto-calibrating prompt instructions, and shifting PTU capacity incrementally

scenarios.scenario: Surviving Cloud Model Snapshot Retirements (`gpt-4-0613 -> gpt-4o-2024-11` or `Claude 3.5 -> 3.7`) Without Silent Behavioral Regressions
scenarios.question: Every 6–9 months, cloud providers retire pinned model snapshots; when a bank let Azure auto-upgrade 45 apps overnight (`Tier 1`), 24.5% of workflows broke due to changed JSON markdown wrappers, +38% verbosity inflation, and stricter false-positive safety refusals
scenarios.model_answer: Never enable blind `Auto-Upgrade` in production (`Tier 1`, `24.5%` regression rate)! Use a **3-Stage Zero-Regression Migration Pipeline** at the AI Gateway: (1) **30 Days Before Retirement**: enable **`5%` Asynchronous Shadow Mirroring** (live user requests are served by `Model_v1`, while the gateway forks a non-blocking copy to `Model_v2` on off-peak/PAYGO capacity); (2) **Automated Drift Diffing**: compare `(Response_v1, Response_v2)` on **JSON Schema validity, token length ratio, tool-call argument match, and refusal rate**; (3) **Canary Cutover (`10% -> 50% -> 100%`)** (`0.2%` regression rate)!
scenarios.tier1_3_failure: Tier 1 discovers behavioral drift only after customers complain in production; Tier 2's 50 manual test prompts miss long-tail edge cases.

scenarios.scenario: Catching the 'Hidden +40% Output Verbosity Tax' When Upgrading to a Newer Model Snapshot
scenarios.question: When upgrading to a newer model snapshot, accuracy looked fine in manual tests (`Tier 2`), but the new model became 42% more chatty/verbose—causing P95 latency and output token bills to jump by 40% in production
scenarios.model_answer: Include a **Token-Length & Latency Drift Gate (`|OSL_v2 - OSL_v1| / OSL_v1 <= 10%`)** in the Shadow Evaluation harness! When `Model_v2` exhibits verbosity inflation (`+42%` output tokens), trigger **Automated Prompt Calibration (`DSPy / PromptFlow Optimizer`)** to inject concise length constraints and few-shot exemplars against the 500 shadow traces before shifting live traffic!
scenarios.tier1_3_failure: Tier 2 and Tier 3 check only semantic correctness while ignoring output token inflation that blows up PTU capacity and latency.

scenarios.scenario: Zero-Waste `PTU / Provisioned Throughput` Capacity Migration During Blue-Green Model Cutover
scenarios.question: If we have 150 PTUs pinned to `Model_v1`, how do we migrate to `Model_v2` without paying for 300 PTUs (double reservation cost) during the 2-week migration window?
scenarios.model_answer: Execute a **Rolling Step-Wise PTU Reallocation (`20% Step Slices`)** coordinated with the AI Gateway: (1) run the `5%` Shadow Phase on **Serverless PAYGO / Night Batch** (`0` extra PTUs needed); (2) once certified, shift PTUs in **3 rolling steps (`30 PTUs -> 75 PTUs -> 150 PTUs`)** while the AI Gateway's weighted router matches the exact `[20/80 -> 50/50 -> 100/0]` split—maintaining `0%` double-PTU waste and `< 6-second` (`0.1m`) instant traffic rollback!
scenarios.tier1_3_failure: Provisioning a second full-sized PTU deployment for weeks doubles monthly cloud reservation bills.

scenarios.scenario: Automated Few-Shot & System-Prompt Optimization (`DSPy MIPROv2`) to Fix Model-Upgrade Prompt Drift in 2.5 Days
scenarios.question: Across 60 microservices, manually re-tuning prompts that regressed on the new model version takes 28 engineering-days (`Tier 1`)
scenarios.model_answer: Feed the failing shadow pairs `(Input, Expected_v1_Output, Failed_v2_Output)` into an **Automated Prompt Optimizer (`DSPy MIPROv2 / TextGrad`)** connected to your **Prompt Registry**, automatically synthesizing and verifying the updated `Model_v2` prompt variant in **`2.5 days` (`96.5%` automated remediation, `$16K` vs `$195K` per wave)**!
scenarios.tier1_3_failure: Manually debugging prompt drift by trial-and-error across 60 teams stalls feature velocity every time a model deprecates.

perturbation_checks.check: New Model Snapshot Introduces Subtle Tool-Call Argument Drift (`date` Emitted as `MM/DD/YYYY` Instead of `YYYY-MM-DD`)
perturbation_checks.perturbed: 0.1% Regression (Shadow AST Tool-Diff Engine Catches Regex/Format Mismatch on Day 1 of 5% Shadow Traffic)

perturbation_checks.check: Emergency Provider Security Deprecation Requiring Full Fleet Cutover Within 72 Hours
perturbation_checks.perturbed: 1.2-Day Lead Time (Parallel 20% Shadow Sampling + Automated DSPy Prompt Calibration Certifies 45 Apps in 28 Hours)

key_findings: Tier 4 (AI Gateway 5% Async Shadow Mirroring + Pairwise Diff Judge + Automated Prompt Calibration + Rolling Step-Wise PTU Shift) reduces post-upgrade silent regressions from 24.5% (Tier 1 Auto-Upgrade) to 0.2% and cuts per-wave migration cost by 91.8% ($16K vs $195K).
Monitoring output token length ratio (`OSL_v2 / OSL_v1`) during shadow testing prevents silent +40% verbosity inflation from exhausting PTU capacity after cutover.
Executing shadow testing on PAYGO/off-peak capacity followed by a 3-step rolling PTU reallocation (20% -> 50% -> 100%) eliminates double-PTU reservation waste.
